global_scenarios.basis: Configured scenarios only — the same honesty rule as Session 08 disasters and Session 04 crisis scenarios: a global scenario enters a world only through trigger_global_scenario with a scenario id from this list, is recorded as a crisis_record whose details name the scenario, propagates through the Session 04 crisis effects surface (demand factor on household consumption + intercity trade movement), and resolves after its configured duration. Nothing here fires on a dice roll.

scenarios.basis: SIM MODEL: external supply interruption scales household consumption takings and intercity inventory movement by takings_factor for the duration (the Session 04 demand-shock channel, labelled as a scenario in its record).
scenarios.title: International supply disruption

scenarios.basis: SIM MODEL: an external demand contraction through the Session 04 demand_shock channel (takings_factor on consumption + trade), labelled as a scenario in its record.
scenarios.title: Global recession (demand shock)

notes: Session 10 integration layer configuration. Everything here is a documented derivation or a labelled SIM MODEL parameter — no value in this file is presented as measured real-world data. The event registry is an index over the existing history tables (it copies references, never rewrites them); technology levels are derived indices computed from research_records + measured education levels by the formula stated in 'technology'; global scenarios are the configured, labelled exogenous door (the Session 04 crisis machinery is the propagation surface).

resources.basis: Consolidated per-city balances computed from existing records only: stored food/agricultural/manufactured goods from business_inventory (business -> property -> district -> city), monthly production/consumption from inventory_movements + household_consumption, water from env_water_state + the Session 08 monthly availability index, fuel from vehicles.fuel_litres + the Session 07 monthly statistics. Shortage flags are raised only where a documented basis exists below; quantities without a basis are reported unflagged.
resources.food_shortage_basis: SIM MODEL flag basis: stored food (food_basket + fish) below 0.25 adult-month units per resident is flagged food_shortage_risk — a reporting threshold, not a physical law.
resources.water_stress_basis: SIM MODEL flag basis: a groundwater_index below 0.3 (the Session 08 hydrology store, 0..1) is flagged water_stress.

technology.basis: SIM MODEL derived index (not a measured quantity): level(field) = min(max_level, publications_weight * publications(field) + education_weight * credentialed_share), where publications(field) counts research_records whose research field maps to the technology field below, and credentialed_share is the fraction of living adults holding a certification (Session 06 certifications table). Recomputed monthly and persisted with its basis so every level is auditable back to the records it came from.
